sql: with m as (select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) as series, market_ticker, case when assumed_price between 93 and 95 then 'a 93-95' when assumed_price between 90 and 92 then 'b 90-92' when assumed_price between 85 and 89 then 'c 85-89' else 'd 96-98' end as band, avg(pnl/nullif(quantity,0))*100 as c_per_ct from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not ilike '%\_pt%' and side='no' and assumed_price between 85 and 98 and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and created_at >= '2026-08-11' and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXINX','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWCMENTION') group by 1,2,3) select band, count(*) as mkts, round(avg(c_per_ct)::numeric,2) as c_per_ct, sum(case when c_per_ct<0 then 1 else 0 end) as losers, round(sum(case when c_per_ct<0 then 1 else 0 end)::numeric*100/count(*),1) as loss_pct from m group by 1 order by 1
